nodes.speaker: com
nodes.text: During landing, Earth hears us 11 minutes late. How do we report in?

variants.text: Our dish gave us trouble and we skipped its check. How do we report in during landing?
Our weak antenna struggled all cruise. Landing signals take 11 minutes to reach Earth, so how do we report in?
Our radios are in great shape thanks to the comms check. How do we report in during landing?

nodes.fact: During Perseverance's landing, orbiters like Mars Odyssey relayed its signals home, because Earth was 11 minutes away.

nodes.speaker: hq
nodes.text: Seven minutes of terror are over, but Earth only learns the result 11 minutes after it happened.

variants.text: The orbiter relayed our touchdown beep to Earth. Mission Control cheers, 11 minutes late.
No relay, so Earth heard nothing yet. Mission Control is silent and waiting for a sign.

nodes.fact: NASA calls the landing 'seven minutes of terror' because Earth cannot help. The lander must do everything alone.
